_comment_TelemetryOptions: Telemetry is opt-in. Set OTEL_METRICS_ENABLED=true or OTEL_TRACES_ENABLED=true and point OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT at your collector (default http://localhost:4317). Keys set in TelemetryOptions, such as Metrics.Enabled, take precedence over the matching OTEL_* variables.
